name: Rule of the Air
desc: Only airborne foes can be hurt. Launch them, then strike.

name: Rule of the Mark
desc: Only foes suffering a status can be hurt. Burn, chill, shock or root them first.

name: Rule of Standing
desc: Dodging is forbidden. Move, block with timing, and strike between their blows.

name: Rule of the Runes
desc: Standing on a lit rune empowers you; foes on a rune are shielded.
